note: Absolute performance targets from docs/ROADMAP.md, checked by scripts/perf_gate.py (DESIGN.md section 11). A side names a run (a results file <run>.json in bench/results/<fingerprint-id>/, written by bench/run.sh) and the benchmarks it matches (a full regex on the Google Benchmark name, or an exact 'benchmark'); 'min_median' picks the best point of a sweep. A target is evaluated when every side is available on the fingerprint being gated and at least one side is a run given on the gate's command line; otherwise it is reported as not applicable. Numbers are never compared across fingerprints (D9, D13).
